Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Class MongoConnectionString

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.MongoConnectionString
public final class MongoConnectionString extends Object
Pure, dependency-free parser for a MongoDB connection string (URI), following the connection-string spec.

This deliberately does not use the MongoDB driver: it is plain string parsing so it can be exercised entirely offline. It also never performs SRV DNS resolution — a mongodb+srv:// URI is parsed and flagged, but the SRV/TXT lookup is left to the caller.

Grammar handled: 

   mongodb://[username:password@]host1[:port1][,host2[:port2],...][/[defaultauthdb]][?opt=val&...]
   mongodb+srv://[username:password@]host[/[defaultauthdb]][?opt=val&...]
Userinfo, the default auth database, and option keys/values are percent-decoded. Option keys are case-insensitive per the spec and are normalized to lower-case.
